titleBack: You Truly Belong Here With Us

flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToBack.prose: Flip if (a) you control two Cloud City battleground sites, (b) you occupy Bespin system, and (c) opponent controls NO Cloud City site. Three-leg conjunction with an opponent-zero constraint.

children.req: occupies >=1 location (plain presence; captives+excluded included in spot)

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if opponent controls MORE Cloud City sites than you (strict count comparison; battleground not required on either count).

children.gameConditions: Filters.countTopLocationsOnTable(game, Filters.and(Filters.Cloud_City_site, Filters.controls(opponent, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE))) > Filters.countTopLocationsOnTable(game, Filters.and(Filters.Cloud_City_site, Filters.controls(playerId, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE)))

requirementSemantics: Front leg A = plain CONTROL of 2 Cloud City BATTLEGROUND sites (Filters.Cloud_City_battleground_site).
Front leg B = plain OCCUPY Bespin system (presence only; spot override includes captives and excluded-from-battle).
Front leg C = OPPONENT-ZERO: opponent may not control even one Cloud City site (any CC site, battleground or not).
Back flip = RELATIVE COUNT on ALL Cloud City sites: opponent strictly ahead. Ties keep back up; you can hold the back with zero sites if opponent also has zero.

Spot override inconsistency in source: front uses INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE for your controls but INCLUDE_CAPTIVE_AND_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE for Bespin occupy and opponent controls; back uses INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE on both counts.
typedIdentities: Filters.Bespin_system - front occupy leg + setup deploy
Filters.Cloud_City_site - front opponent-zero leg + back count comparison
Filters.Cloud_City_location + specialLocationConditions Filters.battleground - front once-per-turn download target
Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.character, Filters.canMoveAsReactAsActionFromOtherCard(self, false, 0, false)) - back react mover
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (front, required): deploy Bespin system from Reserve Deck. Card301_002.java:46-52
Setup (front, required): deploy a Cloud City site that will be a battleground (DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect with specialLocationConditions Filters.battleground). Card301_002.java:53-59
Setup (front, optional): deploy Weather Vane (0-1 copies) from Reserve Deck. Card301_002.java:60-65

Front, once per turn, cost 1 Force (GameTextActionId.CITY_IN_THE_CLOUDS__DOWNLOAD_CLOUD_CITY_BATTLEGROUND_SITE): download a Cloud City battleground location from Reserve Deck. NOTE front-only; the back does not repeat it. Card301_002.java:70-93
Back, once per game (GameTextActionId.YOU_TRULY_BELONG_HERE_WITH_US__DOWNLOAD_CLOUD_CITY_CELEBRATION): download Cloud City Celebration. Card301_002_BACK.java:56-71

Back, once during your control phase, cost 2 Force (GameTextActionId.YOU_TRULY_BELONG_HERE_WITH_US__UPLOAD_INTERRUPT): take an Interrupt into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Card301_002_BACK.java:73-92
otherObligations: Back (once per turn, optional trigger): move your character as a 'react' to a battle or Force drain initiated by opponent at a Cloud City site. Card301_002_BACK.java:98-139
No drain modifiers, no deploy bans, no hard-lose conditions on either side.

Strategic: front requires simultaneous board sweep (2 CC battleground sites + Bespin presence + opponent locked out of ALL CC sites); back only requires not falling behind on CC site control, so the flip threshold is far stricter than the hold threshold.

profileGaps: flipGateSite is null; gates are Cloud City battleground sites + Bespin system (both present in objectiveNamedLocations but not designated as flip gates)
opponent-zero constraint (opponent controls no Cloud City site) and back-side relative-count law have no profile representation
keyCharacterFilter null (flip genuinely needs no actor - acceptable, but nothing marks front download as front-only/lost-after-flip)
